tickets.title: Bundle Cache
tickets.success_criterion: bundle() runs once, caches, reuses. Second render skips bundle.
tickets.primary_approach: Add module-level cached bundle state keyed by SHA256 of remotion-app/src and reuse the resulting serveUrl in renderFromManifest().
tickets.fallback_approach: If full content-addressed caching is unstable, fall back to process-lifetime caching with explicit invalidation on entry-point hash mismatch.

tickets.title: Vertical Resolution
tickets.primary_approach: Lock JosephEdit composition metadata and layout to vertical Shorts dimensions, then clamp text placement in the composition seam.
tickets.fallback_approach: If dynamic metadata gets noisy, hard-code composition metadata first and defer non-essential responsive logic.

tickets.title: Physics Engine
tickets.primary_approach: Implement a precomputed typed-array physics engine with no hot-loop allocations.
tickets.fallback_approach: If the full generalized engine misses the target, ship a narrower per-word transform generator optimized for Joseph text primitives only.

tickets.title: Font Fallback
tickets.primary_approach: Make DOM canvas fallback the primary text rasterization path and ensure deterministic texture generation.
tickets.fallback_approach: If DOM canvas becomes too slow in preview, preserve it in render path and gate preview degradation explicitly.

tickets.title: R3F Integration
tickets.success_criterion: Reads Float32Array from inputProps. No real-time physics.
tickets.primary_approach: Wire JosephEdit to consume precomputed physics data through props and keep runtime rendering dumb.
tickets.fallback_approach: If full typed-array ingestion is blocked, ship a narrower adapter that maps precomputed word transforms into Joseph-only R3F meshes.

tickets.title: Render Entry Contract
tickets.success_criterion: Joseph-specific entry point. No unrelated app code.
tickets.primary_approach: Create a Joseph-only render entry that registers only the Joseph composition and isolates bundle cost from unrelated app surfaces.
tickets.fallback_approach: If total isolation is blocked, create a minimal entry wrapper that excludes editor/preview-only modules from the Joseph render path.

tickets.title: Asset Contract
tickets.success_criterion: Explicit browser vs. FFmpeg media paths.
tickets.primary_approach: Introduce a dedicated asset resolver seam that distinguishes browser-facing URLs from FFmpeg-facing file paths.
tickets.fallback_approach: If a generic resolver is too broad, ship a Joseph-specific resolver first and generalize later.

tickets.title: Chrome Timeout
tickets.primary_approach: Harden render orchestration with timeout enforcement, cleanup, and explicit retry/fail context.
tickets.fallback_approach: If process-group kill semantics differ across OSes, implement the timeout with a narrower but reliable Chrome child cleanup path first.

tickets.title: Integration Test
tickets.primary_approach: Build the quick/full proof harness around the actual Joseph render path with deterministic checks and bounded runtime.
tickets.fallback_approach: If the full quick proof is still too heavy, narrow to a single composition path and sequence the deterministic checks until bundle/serve overhead is reduced.

tickets.title: Candidate Generation
tickets.success_criterion: Emits 2-6 candidate Treatment Genomes per profile.
tickets.primary_approach: Refactor the Director Adapter to emit a bounded candidate set keyed by profile and variation inputs.
tickets.fallback_approach: If a full candidate graph is too big for Phase 1, emit a smaller bounded set with explicit doctrine variants and keep selection external.

tickets.title: Judgment Layer
tickets.primary_approach: Implement the governor as an explicit scoring/veto seam over candidate Treatment Genomes.
tickets.fallback_approach: If full scoring is too broad, ship a veto-first Judgment Layer with thresholded rejection and deterministic tie-breaks.

tickets.title: Replay Ledger
tickets.primary_approach: Create a local persisted Replay Ledger for prior output comparison and variation evidence.
tickets.fallback_approach: If SQLite integration is blocked, ship a JSONL-backed local ledger behind the same interface.

tickets.title: Dynamic Boundaries
tickets.success_criterion: Cuts land on beats, not mid-word.
tickets.primary_approach: Make phrase boundaries, beat snapping, and semantic timing explicit in the Director Adapter.
tickets.fallback_approach: If full phrase semantics slips, ship stronger beat/onset lock and phrase-gap boundaries first.

tickets.title: Sequence Memory
tickets.success_criterion: State machine: calm, building, saturated, recovering.
tickets.primary_approach: Implement Sequence Memory as an explicit state machine with deterministic transitions and outputs.
tickets.fallback_approach: If the full state surface is too broad, ship a smaller saturation/recovery state machine first and expand later.

tickets.title: Band-Pass Ducking
tickets.primary_approach: Implement vocal-band ducking first and derive fallback volume automation from transcript timing if filter support is missing.
tickets.fallback_approach: If sidechain filters vary across FFmpeg builds, standardize on deterministic volume automation in MVP.

tickets.title: SFX Variations
tickets.success_criterion: 40 cues generated. Director selects seeded variation.
tickets.primary_approach: Expand the SFX library to the fixed cue contract and keep seeded selection inside the Director Adapter.
tickets.fallback_approach: If all 40 assets cannot land in sprint, preserve the cue contract and fill missing slots with placeholder variants.

tickets.title: Variation Contract
tickets.primary_approach: Implement explicit variation-key generation and deterministic reuse rules for same-key vs different-key runs.
tickets.fallback_approach: If full source/prompt fingerprinting is too broad initially, ship upload_instance_id + retry_index first behind a stable interface.

tickets.title: Full Integration
tickets.success_criterion: --full passes. 3 profiles distinct. Re-upload variation works.
tickets.primary_approach: Exercise the complete local-first Joseph path with full render settings and explicit variation checks.
tickets.fallback_approach: If the full path is still too slow, keep the same assertions but stage them sequentially with artifact reuse and cached bundle/service setup.

tickets.title: Evidence Preservation
tickets.primary_approach: Persist candidate sets, rejected candidates, review verdicts, and chosen genomes for future learning.
tickets.fallback_approach: If the full artifact set is too large initially, persist chosen and rejected genome summaries first with stable IDs.
